notes: F5-TTS v1 Base (f5-tts 1.1.22, SWivid/F5-TTS F5TTS_v1_Base step 1250000 plus the Vocos vocoder, about 1.4 GB). The shim wraps the F5TTS API with a fixed seed and honours speed. It has no native cue tags. One CPU line took 79 s warm on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23), so it is GPU tier only.
